newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche no comment on Zeneca report.
newsitem.headline: Roche no comment on Zeneca report.

text.p: Roche Holding AG declined comment on a Swiss newspaper report citing rumours that the company was in talks to acquire and break up Zeneca Group Plc.
"We don't comment on such things," a Roche spokesman said, adding the company did not plan any big announcement today.
The Cash weekly reported renewed rumours "that do not come from financial circles" that Roche would offer between 21 and 22 pounds per Zeneca share.
The unsourced report said the deal, to be carried out in phases, envisioned selling off Zeneca's agricultural and specialty chemicals divisions, which account for half its sales.

"At the same time Roche will part with its fragrances and aromas division," the report said, adding it would raise the rest of the money it would need for the 45 billion Swiss franc deal on capital markets.

Roche has regularly been rumoured to be eyeing Zeneca as a takeover target, but Cash itself said analysts thought such a deal would be premature for Roche and too expensive to make without diluting profits.
In London, a Zeneca spokesman said the company does not comment on market rumours.
